description:
## Why This Exists

post/ipfs_write.rs defines FailingIpfsStore inside a #[cfg(test)] mod tests block. It is not re-exported. Other test files (tests/fault_store_errors.rs, tests/e2e_data_flow.rs) that need fault-injection capabilities must either duplicate the struct or use the real MemIpfsStore which cannot inject faults.

## Acceptance Criteria

Move FailingIpfsStore to a test utility module (e.g. src/test_utils.rs or src/post/test_helpers.rs) behind #[cfg(test)] pub. Export it for use by integration tests.
title: Rust idiom: FailingIpfsStore test helper is private to ipfs_write.rs but needed by other tests
